criterion.title: Context-Only Prompt Structure
criterion.given: LLM receives a query with context
criterion.then: prompt contains structured sections: Instructions to answer only from context, Retrieved context chunks with clear boundaries, Original user query, Example format for responses

criterion.title: No Outside Knowledge
criterion.then: LLM never references outside knowledge or general facts AND response stays within the scope of provided documents

criterion.title: Insufficient Context Handling
criterion.given: context chunks don't answer the query
criterion.then: LLM responds: "I don't have information about that in the knowledge base." AND no error is thrown AND query is marked for HITL review (low confidence)

criterion.title: Clear and Structured Response
criterion.then: response is clear, concise, and well-structured AND includes relevant details from context

criterion.title: Token Streaming with SSE
criterion.then: response is streamed token-by-token using Server-Sent Events

criterion.title: Reasonable Response Length
criterion.then: response length is reasonable (50-500 words typical) AND max_tokens enforced at 512

criterion.title: Empty Context Handling
criterion.then: empty context is handled gracefully AND response is "I don't have information..."

criterion.title: Contradictory Context Handling
criterion.then: generation doesn't break AND response acknowledges multiple viewpoints or sources

backend.package: Python client for Ollama LLM API

constraints.constraint: Context-only enforcement: LLM must NEVER use outside knowledge or hallucinate facts not in context
First token latency <500ms for responsive user experience
Full response latency <3s for typical answers (~200 tokens)
Max tokens=512 to prevent overly long responses
Insufficient context handled gracefully: "I don't have information..." (no error)
Timeout after 30 seconds to prevent hanging connections
SSE format for real-time token streaming to client

interface.name: POST /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/query
interface.signature: POST /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/query { query: str, conversation_history: [...], stream: bool } -> SSE stream or JSON
interface.notes: Streaming via Server-Sent Events if stream=true. Returns complete JSON if stream=false. Requires authentication.

interface.name: LLMService
interface.signature: async def generate_answer(query, context_chunks, conversation_history) -> AsyncIterator[str]
interface.notes: Integrates with Ollama API. Builds structured prompt. Streams tokens. Enforces context-only behavior.

interface.name: AnswerGenerationService
interface.signature: async def generate(bot_id, query, k) -> AsyncIterator[str]
interface.notes: Orchestrates vector search + LLM generation. Handles empty context. Yields streaming tokens.
